detail: npm run cli:pack succeeds but the README never says how to run the CLI; cli/dist/cli.js does not exist (actual entry is cli/cli.js), and the launcher parent gets SIGKILLed under a timeout wrapper while its detached child server keeps serving — no docs explain the spawn/detach behavior.
